title: WooCommerce single-product widget (woocommerce-product-title) inside a container — the SINGLE-context add-widget case
_comment: WP-R06 Pro WooCommerce fixture (10-rest-api.md §8.8; SUPPLEMENT §A.5). A classic `woocommerce-product-title` widget (category woocommerce-elements-single → required_context 'single') nested under a flex container, as POST /pro/woo/add-widget would place it on a single-product theme-builder template. The Woo_Context_Validator classifies this widget 'single' and REQUIRES a single-product doc; placing it on a single-product doc → context_ok:true + inserted. requires.woocommerce note: WooCommerce + the Pro Woo module must be active OR this widget is unregistered (UNKNOWN_WIDGET_TYPE) → the runner SKIPS the fixture (graceful degradation; WooCommerce is NOT installed on the live dev site).
_requires_note: Also requires WooCommerce (the WC plugin) AND the Elementor Pro WooCommerce module to be active; SKIP when woo-not-active. The harness has no native `woocommerce` requires flag (Contract 14 §2), so this note + pro:true gate the fixture.
